content: A mbanu Yasu ad dadake dǝ sǝɗikw bezan
13 A dala Yasu zǝ furakh sar, da tǝ ghǝdzǝva gadzak dǝlva khaya Garasinakh.
Uk sawala sǝg kǝ Yasu ǝn peryuwa, ka sawala udanen ai ngwiyanǝf sǝɗikw bǝzan ǝn giɗe nggitl, kǝ gama zin.
Yanen kǝ uda ǝn giɗǝn giɗe nggitl, na ude dla tǝkha kǝ nggwaɗanan, tsa dǝ tsǝrvayu bi.
Wirva tsǝn nggwaɗa nggwaɗud ǝn tǝ sigakh sar, zǝ dǝvakh sar dǝ tsǝrvayu. Ən nggadla nggadla dǝ tsǝrvayu. Zǝ kǝla dǝg tuse ǝn tǝ kwinda siga sar. Na dadak ndzǝɗe tǝkha kǝ payana bi.
Viɗa zǝ fatsi tsin ǝn giɗǝn nggitl, zǝn tǝ ghuɓ. Ən khula, zǝ khara vǝgha sar tsin dǝ kurakh.
Nǝgha tsin Yasu kǝ bit, ka tsiyif dǝ khway, kǝlgan ad juguv ǝn tǝvuk sar.
Ka khula tsin char, ni, ‘Yasu, Zǝr Yazhigǝl Ndanggan, uɗa ɗangwa tsǝkha dǝ ki? A takaɗkhai ka dǝ ɗakha Yazhigǝl, baka ba dǝ dlaɗ bi.’
A kwargan ndǝkyan, wirva audzala Yasu ǝn kwarar khai kwara kwarne, “Kha sǝɗikw bǝzan, ausǝg sǝgawal ǝn udan.”
Ka ndiɗarwal Yasu kwarne, “War ɗakhaghi?” Ka nggawar khai kwarne, “Ɗakhara Ghamag, wirva zikǝn kǝnd.” ...
Ka gwidǝn tǝkhaval kǝ takaɗ Yasu tsin char, khek lakwtǝrdu tsin sǝgawal ǝn ǝntla khayen.
Nǝg giɗa daguwakh ǝn zighw ǝn tǝ kalam ghuɓ.
A takaɗga wurduwakh ad Yasu, kwarne, “Khaya kǝndanǝf khaya, daks da daguwakhin.”
Ka khayatǝrnǝf, ka sawal sǝɗikw bǝzanakhen, ka dagh itar da daguwakh. Giɗa daguwakhena a ɓa itar dǝb mits. Ka ɗaɗardagh itar dǝgdagh diwa tsǝɓan na kǝ ghay gǝrdz, ka ɓaldagh itar da yuwa, ruga itar.
Ka khwaya li zighw daguwakhen daks da khuɗ kǝsa, zǝ gǝdzar kǝsakh, kwarar khai itar kǝ udakh ad dǝge dzoghǝr. Ka sawala udakhen, dala itar da vaz dǝge dzoghǝr.
Sa tsitar da vak Yasu, ka nǝgha itar ad dadake tsa ghamag sǝɗikw bǝzanakh ǝmb, ǝn ndzǝgan. Dǝ gabag ǝn tǝvǝgha sar, zǝn mǝkǝn sar khwaranyan. Ka gǝdzǝf udakhen.
Liye tsa nǝghan dǝ diyakh tar ad dǝge a dzoghǝr, uk kwara khatra kwara tsitar kǝ udakh, ad dǝge a dzoghǝr dǝ dadake tsa ghamag sǝɗikw bǝzanakh ǝn vǝgh sar, zǝ daguwakhen.
Ka farsa udakhen ad takaɗ Yasu, kǝ ɗuwatǝrda khay tar tsin.
Madǝv Yasu ǝn daks da peryuwen, ka takaɗga ude tsa ghamag sǝɗikw bǝzan ǝn vǝgh sar ad Yasu, kǝ khayarnǝf dǝgal tsin dagh.
Ai ka khayarnǝf ba Yasu bi. Ən dleva yan, ka niya tsin, “Dǝg daks da mǝgh, da vak yakhur, kwara tǝrkhai kwara ad zik zikan na kǝ dǝgakhe a mana khai Dad Zikan, zǝ kwiɗkwiɗǝrve mana khayin.”
Wirva yan, ka tǝkaval sar, ka gwayava tsin ǝn Dikapolis, kǝsakh kǝlɗǝk, ǝn kwarakhdu dǝge a manar khai Yasu. A ndawatǝrǝf, kǝ daghan liye a tsǝnan.
A tsiyanǝf Yasu ad dughw Yayirus ai tsa mǝtsgan, a mbanu tsugun ad nusen
Gwiyoghǝr kǝ Yasu saks da tǝ ghǝdzva gadzak dǝlve tsa dinin, ǝn peryu. Ka tsarghǝra dzakhava udakh zikǝn. Madǝvin tlaɓ ǝn tǝ kalam ghǝdzva gadzaka,
ka nǝg udanen kitakul ǝn tǝb kǝ zikan ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ gud dzakhava Yakhudakh, ɗakhasara Yayirus ka sa. Nǝgha tsin Yasu, ka sagha kǝlgan ad juguv ǝn tǝvuk sar.
A takaɗgan char, ‘‘Khǝɗikan na kǝ dughwara ǝn yanga bi, da mǝts. Tatl ausǝg da bo dǝvagh ǝn tǝf, kǝ mbandu mbǝg tsǝkh, khek ǝmtsǝga tsin.”
Ka dala zǝ Yasu. Ka gatatǝrs dzakhava udakh zikǝn, ka ɓidzanǝf itar. ...
Ka nǝg nusen ǝn vin, ai a zulavan ǝn kǝl vizh vǝg kǝlatǝm mits.
A khǝɓu a dlaɗ char ǝn vak gat nggur, ǝn vak li bǝdu nggur. Kǝɗgan ad khalavuwa dǝge dinin. Dǝmbiyanena, a mbu bi. Ən mbǝra dǝ mbǝra kuzen.
Ka tsǝna nusen ad lavǝn tǝghǝr kǝ Yasu, ka sasǝg tsin shuwakh ǝn tǝb kǝ udakh diwa lǝg Yasu. Ka gǝman ad gabag Yasu.
Wirva a ɗayandagh ǝn rǝvakhuɗ sar kwarne, “Da gǝma ka itsa gabag sara, da mbǝga kǝ.”
Tǝvin tǝvina ghitsga kǝl vizh sar. A tsǝnan ǝn vǝgh sar kwarne a mbu.
Tǝvin tǝvina ka tsǝna Yasu ad sǝgawala kǝ ndzǝɗ ǝn vǝgh sar, a manggan ad tlǝr. Gwiyafkhaya ka ndiɗatǝrwal kǝ dzakhava udakhen kwarne, “War kǝ gǝma gabagari?”
Ka nǝv furakh sar, “Ən nǝgha nǝgha kha dzakhava udakh ǝn tlagva kǝ ɓidza kha ɓidza ndikina, ka ndiɗ kwarne war kǝ gǝmakan nikha?”
Ka ɓalakh di kǝ Yasu, kǝ vaz ude kǝ gǝman.
Fatsiye a audzal nus na tsa dǝge a dzoghǝr dina, ka saks tsin da kǝl juguv ǝn tǝvuk Yasu. Ən tǝga vǝgh sar dǝ gǝdz, ka kwar khai ad khalavuwa jir.
Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “Dughwara, fadǝghǝrofǝga kǝ mbakhu. Dǝg daks dǝ lapi, a mbu khǝn tukw kuzagh.”
Madǝv Yasu dlǝn kwar lava, ka sagh yakhaya kǝ udakh ǝn fǝta Yayirus, mal ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ gud dzakhava Yakhudakh. Nǝv itar tsin, “A mǝtsga dughwagh, uɗa dla dǝg njǝgharu njǝgha tsǝkha kǝ malǝmi?
A baru ba Yasu ad tlim kǝ lave a kwarga itar bi. Ka niya kǝ Yayirus, “Gǝdz biya, fadǝghǝrofǝg bakh.”
A khayanǝf ba Yasu ad gatars gata kǝ itsawar bi, uk Bitrus, zǝ Yakub zǝ zǝrbab sar Yukhan.
Tsugwa tsitar ǝn fǝta mal ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ gud dzakhava Yakhudakh, ka nǝgha nǝgha kǝ Yasu ad yakhaya kǝ udakh ǝn tuwa, yakhaya tsuguna ǝn khul.
Dagh da vak tar, ka ndiɗatǝrwal kwarne, “Uɗa lava tsukur ǝn tuwa zǝ khula ndikini? A mǝtsga ba dughw na ndan bi, ǝn khǝnkhar.”
Ka ghuɓasa ghuɓasa tsitar dǝ nen. Ka lakwtǝral kǝ udakh daghan dǝgal da mel. Ka daks tsin zǝ dad dughwen, zǝ bab sar zǝ furakh sar na khǝkǝrɗ, da vake din dughwen. ...
Khutana tsin dǝva dughwen, ka niya tsin, “Talita kumi.” In kwarne, “Zǝr dughwa, ǝn kwara kha kwara ka, tsiyif tsi.”
Tǝvin tǝvin ka tsiyif zǝr dughwen, ka farsa dǝga tsin ǝn tǝb tar. Dughwena, khi kǝlatǝm mits tsin. Ina kǝ digita a nala kǝ dǝg ndawak tsitar.
A ndǝɗatǝrna Yasu ad tlim chara, kwarne, tsǝna ba itsawar ad lavǝna bi. Ka gwidǝn kwara tǝrkhai kwarne, bara bǝg itar dǝg zuwa kǝ dughwen.
